name: Jorah proactive
description: Jorah's proactive layer: today's picture built by code, open loops saved only after Adam's card, restraint in code (classes, budget, the five checks, quiet hours, digest, stop and demote, and a record for every decision), and the triggers' tools. It sends nothing itself and reads only the phone service on 127.0.0.1. Every proactive type is off until Adam turns it on.

stateDir.description: Loops, decisions, the outbox and the digest; mode 700

typesFile.description: config/proactive/types.json: the catalogue of proactive types

enabledTypes.description: Types Adam turned on, one by one after reading each preview card. Empty: Jorah says nothing unasked

includeHealth.description: Pass health fields from the phone service (Adam's decision H); off by default

phoneTokenFile.description: The read-only token for the phone service, mode 600

contractsDir.description: packages/contracts/phone: the schemas the phone's answers are checked against

quietStart.description: Quiet hours start, HH:MM (proposal 22:30 until Adam sets it)

quietSetByAdam.description: True once Adam has chosen the quiet hours

awakeEndsQuiet.description: The phone's alarm-stopped or wake event ends the morning's quiet hours

busyFocuses.description: Focus modes that count as busy for P2

briefFallback.description: Morning brief time when no alarm is seen, HH:MM

briefLatest.description: No morning brief after this time, HH:MM
